@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+import unittest
+
+from enum import Enum
+
+
+class Directions(Enum):
+    DOWN_ONLY = frozenset({"sc"})
+    SOUTHBOUND = frozenset({"sc"})
+
+
+class UnhashableDirections(Enum):
+    DOWN_ONLY = {"sc"}
+    SOUTHBOUND = {"sc"}
+
+
+class EnumLookupRegressionTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_unhashable_value_matches_hashable_member_value(self):
+        self.assertIs(Directions({"sc"}), Directions.DOWN_ONLY)
+
+    def test_hashable_value_lookup_and_alias_are_preserved(self):
+        self.assertIs(Directions(frozenset({"sc"})), Directions.DOWN_ONLY)
+        self.assertIs(Directions.SOUTHBOUND, Directions.DOWN_ONLY)
+
+    def test_unhashable_value_lookup_and_alias_are_preserved(self):
+        self.assertIs(UnhashableDirections({"sc"}), UnhashableDirections.DOWN_ONLY)
+        self.assertIs(UnhashableDirections.SOUTHBOUND, UnhashableDirections.DOWN_ONLY)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
